title: Valuation Sheet of the Equity Desk: What Moves When a Membership and Patronage Equity Account Is Signed Over
content:
**The equity standing.** The equity standing on a membership is the equity portions and capital retains credited to it on the equity ledger, less everything that has been revolved out, rounded to two decimal places.

**The recording charge.** The charge for recording the transfer is the class's own transfer fee, as the class schedule carries it.

**What else enters the sheet.** Nothing is taken off for what the member owes the cooperative, no charge is made for the certificate, no common stock is redeemed alongside the equity and no undelivered cash is carried in.

**The sum.** The equity standing, the cash carried in and the stock redeemed are added; the offset, the recording charge and the certificate charge are then taken off that sum; where the remainder would be less than nothing, nothing moves; and the result is rounded to two decimal places. Every amount in this reckoning is carried to two decimal places, a half cent rounding up.

## The sheet on hypothetical figures

| Line | Quantity | Figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | equity portions credited on the equity ledger | 9400.00 |
| 2 | capital retains credited on the equity ledger | 1260.00 |
| 3 | everything revolved out | 2150.00 |
| 4 | equity standing, being lines 1 and 2 added and line 3 taken off, rounded to two decimal places | 8510.00 |
| 5 | cash carried in | 0.00 |
| 6 | stock redeemed | 0.00 |
| 7 | offset for what the member owes | 0.00 |
| 8 | recording charge, being the class's own transfer fee | 50.00 |
| 9 | certificate charge | 0.00 |
| 10 | what moves, being lines 4, 5 and 6 added and lines 7, 8 and 9 taken off, rounded to two decimal places | 8460.00 |

## A second illustration

A membership whose equity standing is 30.00 on a class whose transfer fee is 50.00 reaches a remainder of less than nothing on the same sheet. Nothing moves, and the figure recorded is 0.00 rather than a negative one. This is how Membership and Patronage Equity settles what passes to a transferee.
